our_title: gotst ignores SCOTCH_graphOrderLoad() status (forwarded from G15)
ran: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-dev-workspace-pyscotch/087f3d41-a5d8-4b0a-9260-769d70cf8179/scratchpad/work/G27-seq-tools/repro/PS2-G15-6/README: `gotst p.grf bad.ord /dev/null` (pristine and patched, 32/64) -> `gotst: ERROR: orderLoad: bad input (3)`, rc=1; nothing runs after the failed load.
read_only: order_io.c orderLoad(): every `return (1)` is preceded by errorPrint (lines 14-47 of the routine, incl. G15's new checks); library_graph_order.c SCOTCH_graphOrderLoad() only forwards that status.
evidence: gotst.c:167 `SCOTCH_graphOrderLoad (&grafdat, &ordedat, C_filepntrordinp);` unchecked, but all Scotch programs link libscotcherrexit whose SCOTCH_errorPrint() ends with `exit (EXIT_FAILURE);` (library_error_exit.c:142), and every failure path of orderLoad() calls errorPrint() first. No tool checks SCOTCH_graphLoad() either (amk_grf.c:172, gout_c.c:206, gbase.c:145, gotst.c:155, gmtst.c:149, gmap.c:369, gord.c:246): this is the tools' design. G15 saw the program continue because its harness was linked with libscotcherr.

fix_options.label: b. Leave as is (shipped: no patch)
fix_options.summary: Design of the programs: library errors exit through libscotcherrexit.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He relies on it everywhere in src/scotch.

fix_options.label: a. Check the status (G15's diff)
fix_options.tested: untested: harmless hardening only (unreachable with libscotcherrexit).
fix_options.tradeoffs: Would only matter if a tool were relinked against libscotcherr.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Harmless, inconsistent with the other load calls he leaves unchecked.

our_title: archDecoArchBuild() ignores archDecoArchBuild2()'s status: SCOTCH_archBuild0() returns 0 with an empty architecture

Patched: returns 1.
evidence: arch_deco_build.c:356 `archDecoArchBuild2 ((ArchDeco *) (void *) &tgtarchptr->data, termdomnbr, termdommax, termverttab, termdisttab);` then `return (0);` at :362; archDecoArchBuild2() returns 1 after `bad maximum terminal`, `bad terminal count`, `terminal domain is not a leaf`, `invalid null distance` (arch_deco.c:138-203) and has freed the body with archDecoArchFree() (fields set to NULL, so a later archExit is safe).

fix_options.tested: api_list d on 32/64; check_scotch_arch*, check_prog_amk_grf, whole check.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Callers now see the failure; the body is left as archDecoArchBuild2() leaves it (class set, NULL tables), which archExit() handles.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Same as G03's `propagate archDecoArchBuild2's result` in archDecoArchLoad (804d101).

fix_options.label: b. Also reset the architecture body on failure
fix_options.tradeoffs: Mirrors d555f2c's memSet after a failed load, but archDecoArchFree() already leaves a safe body.
